prompts.hayloft-v1.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated image-to-3D reference for a premium children's toy farm game. A compact tall wooden hayloft, shown as an open cutaway barn storage platform without a roof. Four substantial softly rounded honey wood corner posts support a thick square plank deck at the upper level. Ground to upper deck height is about the same as the deck width; deck depth is about 0.83 of its width. The under-deck space is tall and open at the front, with sturdy diagonal wooden braces along the sides and a few muted barn-red vertical wooden planks on the rear wall underneath the deck. Two small beautiful golden straw bales tied with thick cream twine sit together at the BACK LEFT corner of the top deck; their combined footprint is less than one third of the deck. They are clearly recognizable as hay, chunky rounded straw blocks with a few broad sculpted straw grooves, not grass or a pile of sticks. A short barn-red retaining board just behind the hay; the FRONT and RIGHT HALF of the top deck remain completely clear and flat for a small kitten to stand and transfer to a lift alongside it. No kitten, no animal, no people, no ladder, no stairs, no roof, no rail across the front or right edge of the upper deck. Beautiful tactile painted wood toy finish, warm natural colors, cream beam ends, restrained grain, softly rounded robust geometry, consistent with hand-painted toy farmhouse models. One coherent assembled structure only, whole object in frame, three-quarter front-right view from a little above so the upper deck is plainly visible. Pure white background, neutral even soft studio light with minimal contact shadow, no dramatic baked shadow. No ground plinth, no landscape, no loose props on the ground, no signs, no letters, no watermark, no collage.
